extracted.intended_audience: Russian companies, patent/technology managers, and patent analytics clients of the FIPS Project Office
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and service-quality criteria for producing and evaluating patent-analytics products (patent landscapes, intelligence, technology acquisition support, training, openness and anti-corruption practices) provided by the FIPS Project Office for corporate and institutional clients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key features of FIPS Project Office products and services
rubrics_metrics.description: The key features of the FIPS Project Office’s products and services are an in-depth technical analysis of the most valuable technologies and products of industry-leading companies, as well as our in-house methodology of insight-driven patent analytics, which provides tailored practical recommendations to Russian companies on how to react to certain activities of the world’s leading companies (such as product development or market launch) in the field of customer’s technological priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes deep technical analysis and an 'insight-driven' methodology that produces tailored, actionable recommendations tied to clients' technological priorities and competitors' actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for the best modern technologies and products
rubrics_metrics.description: search for the best modern technologies and products in the sphere of the customer's interests
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverable should identify current leading technologies/products relevant to client needs; output used to inform R&D and acquisition decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine customer's place on the technological world landscape
rubrics_metrics.description: determining the customer's place on the technological world landscape
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analytics should position the client relative to global players, showing gaps, strengths, and opportunities in patenting and technology capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of strategies for legal protection
rubrics_metrics.description: analyse of the strategies for legal protection of technologies and products of leading companies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess competitors' patenting strategies, scope of protection, jurisdictions, and identify recommended legal-protection approaches for the client.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cataloging of modern technologies and products on a topic
rubrics_metrics.description: cataloging of modern technologies and products on a given topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce organized catalogs/classifications of technologies and products to support decision-making, technology scouting and portfolio management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine maturity and methods of legal protection of technologies
rubrics_metrics.description: determining the maturity and methods of legal protection of technologies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include technology maturity (TRL-like assessment) and recommended protection methods (patenting, know‑how, trade secrets, combined approaches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of product lines of global leading companies
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis of product lines of global leading companies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map competitor product portfolios, highlight which product lines are patent-protected, and derive implications for client product strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring and analysis of promising investment areas
rubrics_metrics.description: monitoring and analyzing of promising investment areas
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track patenting/activity trends to identify investment-worthy technology areas and justify R&D or M&A investment priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of potentially valuable technical solutions in a patent portfolio
rubrics_metrics.description: identification of potentially valuable technical solutions in the patent portfolio
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Screen portfolios to flag commercially or strategically valuable inventions for further protection, licensing or commercialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthening legal protection for valuable technologies and products
rubrics_metrics.description: strengthening legal protection for valuable technologies and products of the customer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend and support measures (additional filings, territorial expansion, combining patenting and know‑how) to improve enforceability and commercial defensibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced patent landscape product features
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced patent landscape is an extension of the Express patent landscape with some important features of the domain-specific patent landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically includes: thorough domain modeling; a detailed search strategy; semi-automatic quality control of the patent collection; selective tagging; description on two model bases. Also imposes restrictions on the number of patent families and search depth; offers reduced research time (2.5 months) and lower cost (2.5x cheaper) compared to domain-specific landscapes—trading scope/depth for speed and price.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive support in acquisition of new technologies (product scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: This product includes a variety of services, the final set of which is determined by the results of expert meetings with the customer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Core services (to be selected/adapted per client) include: identification of potentially patentable solutions based on R&D materials and technical documentation; comparison of the customer’s technologies with those of leading companies; monitoring of technical solutions of competing companies; search for target companies holding desired technologies; assessment of prospects for commercialization combining patenting and know‑how; support for technology transfer in Russia and abroad (with involvement of specialized foreign companies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of promising areas of testing and technology valuation
rubrics_metrics.description: analysis of promising areas of testing: comparison of different technological areas, detailed technological analysis of the most valuable industry technologies, identification of technologies aimed at solving industry problems (service life, accuracy, sensitivity, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverables should compare technology areas, highlight valuable solutions addressing concrete industrial requirements, and inform testing/validation roadmaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modern go-to-market and territorial patent strategy analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: modern go-to-market strategies: analysis of the scope of patent strategies of global leading companies, analysis of the pace and gaps of technology protection in different countries, technologies that are most important for industry leading companies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports should diagnose market-entry considerations tied to IP posture, reveal where competitors are protected or exposed across jurisdictions, and recommend strategic filing/market decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of new application areas and specification contrasts
rubrics_metrics.description: new areas of application of technologies: analysis of the scope and application areas of leading companies’ products, identification of specifications with contrasting modes and methods of application (different voltage, low temperatures, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight alternative use-cases and specification variants to suggest product diversification or alternative commercialization paths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous professional education as competency development
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuous professional education. In 2019, employees of the FIPS Project Office obtained 21 international certificates... Project Office employees undergo continuous training in data mining (Python programming, machine learning, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain staff qualifications via international certificates and technical/data-science training to ensure analytics quality; track certification counts as a competency metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis and updating of knowledge base (Compendium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis of sources and updating the knowledge base on patent analytics. We regularly monitor the most interesting publications in order to compile a Compendium... As of December 31, 2019, the Compendium... includes more than 1 thousand scientific articles and reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep an up-to-date curated compendium of literature, feeds, and prior analyses to inform methodology and ensure reproducibility of analytics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive participation in conferences and forums
rubrics_metrics.description: Proactive participation in conferences and business forums. Project Office specialists participate in almost all Russian and foreign events on patent analytics and technology policy making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage in community knowledge exchange (presentations, moderation, round tables) to validate methods and build partnerships; track events and speaking engagements as quality indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analysis of feedback from completed projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Analysis of feedback from completed projects. As the project completion advances, Project Office employees analyze their progress and the difficulties they have encountered. This practice allows us to make each new project better and more complete...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institute post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and adapt methodologies for sector-specific particularities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational and training program content and availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Educational and training programs on patent analytics. The Project Office held 6 Patent Analytics Lounge seminars on: 1. Technological disclosure 2. Patent families 3. Patent citation 4. Technology transfer 5. Dates 6. Patenting IT solutions. Complete videos are available free on the Project Office’s Facebook channel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide modular training on core patent-analytics topics, make materials publicly available (videos), and integrate offerings into wider educational programs for stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness to partnership and franchisee model with quality indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: In order to scale up technology consulting based on patent analytics, a network of franchisee centers is being developed in the regions of Russia. Such centers perform research in the field of patent analytics (mainly Express patent landscapes) with established quality indicators and under the supervision of the FIPS Project Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use supervised regional centers with standardized quality metrics to scale delivery while maintaining consistent outputs; prioritize win‑win cooperation and cross-border partnerships in related areas (marketing research, know‑how, asset valuation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency, open data and website information practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Development of the official Rospatent website and the 'Open Data' section aimed at increasing satisfaction of citizens and stakeholders with quality, reliability and completeness of information; 23 open datasets updated in machine-readable format; agendas, records and decisions of collegial bodies published timely.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish open data in machine-readable formats, update documentation of boards/committees, expand thematic site sections, and track metrics (views, traffic, publication counts) as measures of openness and user engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public communication and media engagement metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Regular interaction with media representatives... Key publications statistics: Rospatent: 22,048 media references; FIPS: 3,667 media references. Social accounts activity: number of posts, videos published, subscribers, likes, total coverage of publications, website traffic (62,043 unique users/month).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor media references, social posts and engagement, and website traffic as performance indicators for outreach and public information effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anti-corruption measures and HR policy compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Anti-corruption measures: establishment and restructuring of the Commission to comply with official conduct requirements; ongoing monitoring of anti-corruption activities; notifications for other paid work; trust line for reporting corruption; trainings and inspections to identify corruption factors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain procedural safeguards (commissions, monitoring, notifications, training, trust lines), update posted information on anti-corruption, and perform inspections and independent expert reviews to reduce corruption risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-resources recruitment, internships and examiner staffing standards
rubrics_metrics.description: HR policy: publish vacant positions, hold competitions for civil service, implement internship programs ('Inventions and Utility Models', 'Trademarks') with theoretical and practical training; appointment of new examiners (150 appointed in 2019); formation of candidate pools and targeted university engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use structured recruitment, internships with mentorship, and ties with universities to staff examiner positions; track hires, intern-to-hire conversion, and candidate pool metrics as workforce-quality indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological support and guides for provision of public services
rubrics_metrics.description: Special attention is paid to improving methodological support for the provision of public services for state registration of results of intellectual activity. The section 'Regulatory legal acts' contains Guides covering administrative procedures and actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear guides and methodology documents for administrative procedures and public services to increase accessibility and reduce errors in filings and registrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection and publication of 'Patent of the Week' as evaluative curation
rubrics_metrics.description: In the 'Patent of the Week' section, 38 technical solutions were published that, according to examiners of the Federal Institute of Industrial Property, have great potential for implementation and commercialization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate and publish exemplar patents judged by examiners to have high implementation/commercial potential to promote innovation and public awareness.
